# Protobuf source supplied with the local portable ZIP

The local ZIP includes the unmodified Protobuf C++ 3.21.12 source archive for Ubuntu 22.04 machines whose system Protobuf predates proto3 optional support.

Upstream: https://github.com/protocolbuffers/protobuf/releases/download/v21.12/protobuf-cpp-3.21.12.tar.gz

`SHA256SUMS` records the downloaded archive hash. The Linux installer verifies it before extraction. Upstream copyright and LICENSE are included inside the archive and are retained. The tarball is ignored by this source repository and explicitly added by the portable packaging script.
